narrative.overview: Nora SuperIntelligence Lab presents an open-source intelligence architecture as a deep-field technical surface: dark navy grounds, a single luminous teal voice, and quiet white-canvased diagrams. The system reads like a well-lit control room — calm surfaces, precise boundaries, and one bright signal color that always means you can act on this. Every screen is content-first, with long-form prose in measured columns and compact navigation that never shouts.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy layered surfaces with thin low-contrast borders instead of shadows.
One sans voice — self-hosted Public Sans — for display, body, and labels.
A single teal accent family for links and interactive state; pale aqua fills reserved for primary actions.
Diagrams always render on a white canvas so source-extracted SVG stays readable against the dark UI.
Compact sticky navigation and unobtrusive On-this-page indexing; nothing auto-plays.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: The teal family is the only accent voice on the dark field, used for action and focus — never a second accent hue for decoration.

rules.name: The Dark Field Rule
rules.body: Pages are dark navy; Action Aqua and white canvases are the only light masses. Aqua fills belong to primary buttons and step numerals — never panels or page backgrounds.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Public Sans at weights 400-700 is the entire type system; weight and tracking create hierarchy, never a second family.

rules.name: The Tight Head Rule
rules.body: Headings always keep letter-spacing -0.03em and line-height 1.12 in Heading Ink; body copy never inherits that tightening.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards, inputs, and buttons cast no shadow; layer with the three surface colors and borders, reserving shadow for genuinely floating elements.

dos: Do layer the three navy surfaces for depth instead of adding shadows.
Do keep Action Aqua fills on primary CTAs and step numerals only, paired with Cool Canvas text.
Do render every diagram artwork on a white canvas, with concise captions.
Do use the global focus treatment — 3px Muted Aqua-Blue outline with 3px offset — on every interactive element.
Do respect reduced motion and never auto-play diagram animation.
Do keep the accent to the teal family for anything actionable, lifting hover states within the family.
donts: Don't introduce serif or display faces — no Libre Caslon or heritage fonts; Public Sans is the only voice.
Don't put light panels on the dark field outside Action Aqua fills and white diagram canvases.
Don't invent new token names or alias scales; radii are hardcoded per component.
Don't add second accent hues like warning oranges or brand purples.
Don't drop shadows on resting cards or buttons.
Don't make the homepage system map reader-interactive; highlight state comes from page data, not clicks.
